registration.title: Movers, new clubs and shots for xG, released in the club rank
registration.what: Production's club rank takes A16 and A24 together: a club changing division in its own country is moved halfway to its new division's average, new clubs move faster, and a match with shot counts but no xG moves the rank on half goals and half xG estimated from the shots.
registration.why: Both were proven better than production on the final period, and the owner's rule from 2026-10-14 is that a proven gain is implemented whatever its size.
registration.how: The settings their experiments fixed (rating_dynamics combined: pull 0.5, boost 0.5 over 40 matches; shots_proxy: goals weight 0.5, K 10), in ranking.py, as one new match-model version. Nothing else in the model changes.
registration.hypothesis: On live matches the released version has lower result log loss than the version it replaced would have had.

metrics.source: experiments/shots_proxy/results.json: descriptive_stack, the two together on the final period at 95% (already seen, not a registered test)

expected.confidence: Each part was chosen on 2022-07 to 2024-06 and proven on 2024-07 to 2026-10; that period had been looked at before, and the stack of the two was run after both results were known.

registration.success_criteria: Protocol P16: the confidence sequence of released minus re-created old log loss on live matches. Proven better: it stands. Proven worse: the owner decides whether to revert.
